name: A-flat-adventure
prompt:
Create a polished character art direction comparison board for Kokomonster, landscape, very high resolution, white background. Reference 1 is ONLY drawing style inspiration (flat playful expressive game creatures); do NOT draw the Pokemon characters or copy signature. Reference 2 is authoritative Kokomonster anatomy/colours and all-angle identity. Reference 3 is supplementary authored illustration/outfit reference.
Layout EXACTLY two rows of SIX isolated full-body character illustrations, generously spaced, no cropping. Six columns order: Koko, Gohanko, Bear, Rabbit, Yauyau, Tree. Small clean column names. Top row heading PLAIN: neutral lively stance without activity props. Bottom row heading WITH PROPS: same six characters each with a simple activity prop, more expressive pose. Koko reading open cream book; Gohanko holding small tea cup; Bear writing with big pencil in notebook; Rabbit holding folded map; Yauyau examining a leaf through magnifying glass; Tree holding watering can next to tiny sprout. Keep every character recognisable and consistent between rows. Plain means characteristic body/default outfit, not naked costume characters. Rabbit wears red scarf with simple pink paws in BOTH rows; blue boxing gloves are optional sporting costume and omitted in this trial. Props must not hide faces, defining marks or silhouette.
Identity invariants:
Koko navy blue monkey with round peach inner ears, peach heart-shaped face mask, black dot eyes, small muzzle, red cheeks, red heart on chest, long rounded arms, peach feet, long thin curled blue tail.
Gohanko white rounded rice character, black hair fringe and paired black side buns, tan yellow dome hat with brim, tiny black eyes and mouth, red cheek marks, black neck bib, red circle on white flared torso, yellow feet, small circular blue rimmed bag on red shoulder strap.
Bear brown round stocky bear with round ears/pale centres, pale projecting muzzle, black small nose, brows, coral cheeks, white shorts with turquoise waistband, round short tail.
Rabbit pink bunny with long outward ears, black forehead curl and separate small muzzle, red wedge whisker marks on BOTH cheeks, red scarf, pink paws and rounded tail.
Yauyau floating dark charcoal pointed hood enclosing black oval face with white small eyes and mouth, floating red ball above head, red collar and thin long red arms with small hands, tapering legless charcoal body.
Tree chestnut character with pointed grooved brown crown, pale cream face with dot eyes and pink cheeks, red/pink PETAL COLLAR around neck (not ears or wings), green ribbed round body/mitten arms, short pink legs and black shoes.
Keep own signature dot eyes/face design rather than replacing everyone with Pokemon eyes. Maintain recognizable colour families. No extra characters, no 3D rendering, no website mockup, no logo, no signature. A coherent professionally drawn game illustration family.
Title A — FLAT ADVENTURE. Closest to reference 1: confident asymmetric flat cut-paper silhouettes, crisp saturated colour areas, almost no exterior outlines, selective slender dark interior strokes, playful energetic pose rhythm, graphic expressive faces. Zero gradients, zero texture, zero volumetric shading. Charming slightly angular rounded shapes.
